'''Vynock Six''' was the callsign of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Vynock Squadron]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] the squadron participated in the attack on the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Aegis Base]], during which Vynock Six was shot down.
